It maps the command into domain value objects, hands order creation to the Order.place factory, reserves stock through a domain service and saves through the domain OrderRepository port. The file has no business rules, such as validation or quantity and pricing logic, because those are handled by OrderLine.of and Order.place. It also has no persistence, transport or framework code. Calling new Date() to get the placement time is a small orchestration detail, not a misplaced responsibility.
